reviews.title: Great Concept, Terrible Subscription Model!
reviews.text:
GoodShort seems like a promising app with some interesting shows, but I absolutely hate the pay-per-episode system and/ or weekly subscription fees. At least they stayed true to their name—GOODSHORT—because the episodes are incredibly short, averaging about 5 minutes each!

The series I found interesting had around 60 episodes, which sounds like a lot until you realize how quickly you can get through them. What makes it worse is there’s no clear indication of when future episodes will be released, leaving you paying for a subscription without knowing when you’ll get more content.

I don’t mind paying for entertainment, but this pricing model feels like a money grab, especially considering how little content you’re actually getting per episode. I’d much rather pay a reasonable monthly subscription for unlimited access.

I canceled my membership ASAP! Good concept, after I cancelled they keep trying to charge the weekly membership fee!!!!

reviews.text: had this app for 15 minutes and more than half of it was ads. each “episode” is 10 seconds long and to watch the next part you either pay minimum 8 AUD for 500 coins (another 10 episodes) or 30 AUD for the whole series. there is genuinely no reason to be so money hungry. the shows are good, but not for that price and the amount of ads. if they’re was a better system set up that doesn’t force you to watch an ad every 10 seconds or spend more than most make an hour it would be a worthwhile app.

reviews.title: Waste of time trust me!!!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app with the promise that the dramas will be longer and it’s the only one that you need. The commercials that I have to watch are longer than each scene. I watched seven minutes on Facebook. Then it made me watch the exact same seven minutes that took me three days to watch and I still haven’t gotten to through the initial seven minutes after downloading the app total waste of time other apps at least give you 2 to 3 minutes before having you watch a commercial. The sad part about it all is that the drama series that is actually entertaining, but I’ll never finish it because after posting this, I’m gonna delete the app spend my day watching commercials took me 25 minutes to watch possibly four minutes of actual drama and then it’s the same few commercials back to back.
